# Secondary-research insight card template

Card ID/title; publisher/author/date/source URL/local locator; exact scope/population and access level; short attributed finding (no invented quote); limitations/counter-evidence; explicitly labelled design inference; R-/T-/AT- mapping; whether it is a source fact, assumption or simulated scenario; reviewer/date. State “secondary research; no SahiTol primary interview.” Personal identifiers copied from studies are unnecessary.
